categories.labelVi: Tài nguyên và tiền còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with more leftover resources and money wins

endCondition.description: Triggered when the 4th natural disaster is placed in the card market; each player then quits by taking a natural disaster card (reputation 10/6/3/1 depending on player count; last to quit gets none).

notes: family: running-track. Reputation is tracked on the board during play. Quitting players take the natural disaster card giving most reputation (2p: 6,0,0,0; 3p: 10,6,0,0; 4p: 10,6,3,0; 5p: 10,6,3,1). Rulebook does not define whether leftover resources and money are summed or ranked separately; modelled as one combined count. Solo campaign goals not modelled. Verified via a RulesPal mirror of the rulebook, not the PDF.
